name: whatsapp-mcp
description: Send WhatsApp messages and approved templates from your own business number, via Meta's official Cloud API.

access_token.title: Meta access token
access_token.description: A System User permanent token with business_management + whatsapp_business_messaging + whatsapp_business_management. See docs/setup-meta-whatsapp.md.

phone_number_id.title: Phone number ID
phone_number_id.description: The numeric ID shown under WhatsApp > API Setup — not the phone number itself.

waba_id.title: WhatsApp Business Account ID
waba_id.description: Only needed to list message templates.
